title: Alaska (AK) Counties (2.6)
text:
Alaska (AK) Counties (2.6)

FIPS codes for Alaska.

Note:
 
For versions more recent than 
UNICEDE
/2 2.6 see 
Albania CRESTA Codes (v2.8)
.

FIPS State Code: 02
 
Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.
For example, for Denali County, enter 
01-02068
